studies.title: Leaf drift
studies.description: A leaf releases from its branch, turns in the breeze and comes to rest on the ground.

studies.title: Seed germination
studies.description: The shell separates, roots establish, a shoot rises and two cotyledons open in sequence.

studies.title: Water ripple
studies.description: A falling droplet touches the surface and sends three widening ripples across the water.

studies.title: Trail journey
studies.description: A trail is drawn through the landscape while a traveller follows its actual curved route.

studies.title: Fern unfurling
studies.description: A coiled fern rises from the soil as paired leaflets loosen from the stem, working upward to the tip.

studies.title: Dew gathering
studies.description: Small beads travel along a sloping leaf, join at its tip and release one drop into the pond below.

studies.title: Flower opening
studies.description: The outer sepals release the bud; overlapping petals open in sequence to reveal a pollen-rich centre.

studies.title: Butterfly landing
studies.description: A butterfly follows a curved approach, beats its wings independently and folds them gently after landing.

studies.title: Shoreline tide
studies.description: A shallow wash advances over the sand, leaves a fine foam line and withdraws around the shoreline stones.

studies.title: Canopy in the wind
studies.description: A gust flexes the upper branches; leaves and grass respond with a delay and return as the breeze passes.

studies.title: Fireflies at dusk
studies.description: Fireflies drift on separate paths above the reeds, their soft light rising and fading at different moments.

studies.title: Mycelium connections
studies.description: Fine fungal threads branch beneath a fallen log; a nutrient pulse traces a connected path through the network.
